note_en: 来自…的 ("coming from...") turns an origin into a description placed before the noun: 来自两百多个国家和地区的运动员 "athletes from more than two hundred countries and regions." English puts "from..." after "athletes," but Chinese puts the whole 来自… phrase first and links it to the noun with 的. Sentence 10 does the same at greater length: 来自204个国家和地区的一万多名运动员.
